author: Galrandir
body:
LFT

Hello everyone, I have left my previous team and am looking for another :)


About me

I am an experienced PvPer and I fit in position frountlines. I am decently known to the community and if you need me to stream/record a match I can. I normally am available around 3:30-5:00pm, 6:30-8:00pm or 10:00-12:00am GMT TIME!


Experience

I am a experienced team-player. I am good at PvP; mcsg to be precise. I have been in many teams (some of which I have not fit in); TGC (Now known as Apollo), the Emancipators and the team I've recently left, The Pensioners. 

I hope I can fit in! :) msg me on Skype {alex.corbett44} if you're interested :)
